note: Seeded 2026-09-24 from the AI program plan. Pre-registered contracts (stop rules, tournaments, guards) stand as written; the pool rates the same entrants additionally and offers its panel jobs to future runs.

intentions.title: Stronger-3 arm A: distilled afterstate core, outcome PPO
intentions.hypothesis: A 15M-parameter afterstate core distilled from the champion and fine-tuned with outcome PPO beats the champion at the spawn contract.
metrics: pool pooled rating over l14-spawn (report only)
intentions.decision_rule: Pre-registered: stop after two consecutive snapshots whose pooled panel score does not exceed the best so far; the best snapshot is the single tournament candidate (afterstate_stop_rule_v1.py).
intentions.notes: PPO on tf3090 (tmux afterstate-ppo-18h). Snapshots join the pool through watch-run on the Mac data directory; the pool does not replace the pre-registered panel.

intentions.title: Stronger-3 arm C: full-size champion plus zero-initialised afterstate branch, outcome PPO
intentions.hypothesis: Keeping the champion's full network and adding an afterstate branch (warm start, function-identical at step 0) improves on the champion without the distillation loss of arm A.
metrics: pool pooled rating over l14-spawn (report only)
intentions.decision_rule: Pre-registered: the arm A stop rule applied to arm C snapshots (afterstate_full_stop_rule_v1.py).

job.title: Arm C snapshots vs the anchor (report only)

intentions.notes: Queued on tf3090 after arm A. Register snapshots with watch-run on /Users/ethan/dev/drmario/drmc-rl-afterstate-full-data (run armC-ppo-v1).

intentions.title: Stronger-3 arm B: human-corpus-bootstrapped afterstate core, imitation then outcome PPO
intentions.hypothesis: Bootstrapping the afterstate core from human games instead of the champion gives a stronger or more human-compatible starting point for the same PPO.
metrics: pool pooled rating over l14-spawn per snapshot
intentions.decision_rule: Pool stop rule (tools.rating_pool stop-rule --run armB-ppo-v1): stop after two consecutive snapshots whose pooled l14-spawn rating does not exceed the best of the parent and earlier snapshots; select the best.
depends: external:arm B imitation run on green
intentions.notes: Imitation on green, PPO on tf3090 after arm C. New run: hooks into the pool from the start (watch-run --panel-set l14-spawn).

intentions.title: Stronger-3 tournament: arm winners vs the champion
intentions.hypothesis: At least one afterstate arm is promotable over the champion at the spawn contract.
metrics: pool round robin among arm selections, champion and public-core-300m
intentions.decision_rule: Pre-registered per arm: PROMOTE if pooled 95% lower bound > 0.50 and no pace simultaneous 95% upper bound < 0.45; PARITY / REJECT otherwise. The pool round robin is additional evidence only.
intentions.notes: Each arm's selection plays its own pre-registered tournament seeds exactly once (prepare_afterstate_tournament_v1.py tournament). Import the tournament journal afterwards with import-study.

intentions.title: Shipped timing confirmation of the tournament winner
intentions.hypothesis: The spawn-contract winner is not worse than the champion under the shipped lock_safe + repeat timing.
intentions.decision_rule: Pre-registered addendum: FAIL if the pooled 95% lower bound < 0.45, PASS otherwise.
intentions.notes: Frames backend. The pool keeps the l14-shipped condition set rated in the background (weight 0.3).

intentions.title: Stranded edge-virus curriculum variants A+S, C+S, B+S
intentions.hypothesis: A dense stranded-edge start mix decaying to the natural rate over 40-50M frames reduces pills-to-clear on stranded edge viruses without losing general strength.
metrics: pre-registered primary: paired restricted-mean pills to clear (benchmark bank)
guard: 896-game panel vs the fine-tune parent
intentions.decision_rule: Pre-registered: keep a curriculum checkpoint only if the primary success rule and both guards pass; otherwise the parent stands.

job.title: Stranded-edge variants vs their parents (report only)

intentions.notes: Branch trainer/stranded-edge-endgame. The panel guard runs as pre-registered; the pool additionally rates each variant against its parent.

intentions.title: Human-movement fine-tune at Fast, Top Humans and Super Human
intentions.hypothesis: Fine-tuning the champion under human-like movement recovers strength lost to slower human steering at the fast paces.
metrics: pool rating under l14-human-movement vs the motor-limit champion
intentions.decision_rule: Ship human movement at a pace when the fine-tuned core's rating there is within the pool's 95% interval of the motor-limit champion's.
depends: external:real-player data shows human-movement strength at the fast paces
intentions.notes: On hold (user decision Sep 24). Recipe ready on trainer/human-movement-training 9be59275; the pool engine needs that branch's movement model before these conditions can play.

intentions.title: One-ply lookahead retry (Stronger-4)
intentions.hypothesis: One-ply lookahead over the value head beats the policy argmax once the value head ranks alternatives.
metrics: value-head ranking accuracy on held-out alternatives
pool rating vs its base core
intentions.decision_rule: Retry only after the value head ranks alternatives above chance; then promote if the pooled rating exceeds the base core's by more than its 95% interval.
depends: external:value head ranks alternatives above chance
intentions.notes: Shelved Sep 24: the value head ranked alternatives at chance. Branch trainer/one-ply-lookahead.

intentions.title: int8 inference core
intentions.hypothesis: An int8-quantised export of the champion plays at the same strength for a fraction of the browser compute.
metrics: decision agreement with the fp32 parent
pool rating vs the fp32 parent
intentions.decision_rule: Ship when decision agreement >= 99% and the pooled rating difference to the parent is within +/- 15 with 95% confidence.
depends: external:int8 export and a pool loader for it
intentions.notes: Later. Needs a quantised export and a loader registered as a runtime capability.
